profile.headline: Software Engineer 3 at SUPERVALU
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 20 years of Lawson/Infor experience in HR/Payroll, Procurement and Finance applications. For the past four years I've worked at Supervalu, Inc.  Actively searching for opportunities in Lawson/Infor software support, database design and business analyst.

positions.title: Software Engineer 3
positions.description:
	Rewrote the Direct Deposit Lawson Retail Accounting application in Javascript.
	Currently migrating our Save-a-lot banner from Lawson Corporate AP to Oracle Cloud.
	Wrote the Lawson invoice interface program for newly purchased company Unified Grocers to process there invoices into our Lawson Corporate AP system and pay them.
	Wrote the Lawson invoice interface program for newly purchased company Associated Grocers to process there invoices into our Lawson Corporate AP system and pay them.
	Supports the Valupay check printing system including new printer, bank account, paygroup and user configuration.  My Valupay support also includes setup of new banners or paygroups in Valupay and check validations.
	Currently supports the entire Lawson 8.1 Corporate AP & Finance Systems including job scheduling, reprograming and custom scripting. In this role I fix many custom Lawson 4GL programs, write new custom programs for finance and write custom Perl scripts. I also support all aspects of the 1500 job nightly job schedules for Supervalu.
	Supports all interfaces from Lawson Corporate AP to Oracle GL systems.  
	Use SQLPLUS to pull data for reports, lists, review and updating of Lawson Corporate AP data as necessary.

positions.title: Independent Contractor
positions.description: 	Wrote a custom Lawson 4gl online form for capturing IPA process flow work unit information for Capital Requisition Approvals.  The program was called the Capital Requisition User Action Inquiry which displayed both real time and historical records.  The purpose of the program was to review Capital Requisitions already approved and see where existing Capital Requisitions were getting held up.  This was a fifty hour remote project worked remotely.

positions.title: Info Tech Analyst IV
positions.description:
	Wrote Technical Design documents for Lawson Procurement & Finance interfaces, for data conversions, for process flows, Lawson Smart Notes and for Lawson program modifications.
	Wrote new Lawson programs for Laser fiche interfaces for select forms.
	Worked with Infor Smart Reports generating modified PO100 & AP220 reports.
	Provided complete support for all Lawson 4gl forms in Procurement & Finance.  
	Wrote the Journal Entry Approval & Internal Billing JE Approval process flows in IPA
	Provided support for IPA(Infor Process Automation) process flows in Procurement & Finance.  
	Supported the Lawson Business Intelligence(LBI) system for the City of St. Paul as a systems administrator in a backup role.
	Supported the complete Lawson Procurement & Finance systems for LBI, IPA, 4gl and Lawson Security.
	Wrote CMMS queries in SQL Navigator & SQL Plus to pull AR & AP data for the new Lawson procurement & finance system tables

positions.title: Senior Technical Consultant
positions.description:
	Wrote Technical Design documents for Lawson Procurement & Finance interfaces, for data conversions, for process flows and for Lawson 4GL program modifications.
	Wrote new Lawson 4GL programs for Laser fiche interfaces for select forms.
	Created new IPA process flows for Journal Entry Approval and Internal Billing Approval.  
	Supported the Lawson Business Intelligence system for the City of St. Paul.
	Used SQL Navigator to query CMMS legacy system file data for loading into Lawson Procurement & Finance.

positions.title: MMIS Specialist
positions.description:
	Supported all Materials Personnel on Lawson 9.0.1 Applications from a functional and system administrator role.
	Setup new Lawson user ids in RQC as requesters and approvers.  This was for LAUA and Lawson Security.
	Used Lawson add-ins to update vendor contracts, item master, item location, purchase order, vendor name, general ledger and EDI table information. This included EDI vendor setups.
	Used Lawson add-ins to pull vendor contract pricing, vendor, item, item location, purchase order & requisition records. Used vendor contract information with Excel vlookup option to change monthly item pricing.
	Generated Materials and Financial reports using the Toad SQL tool. 
	Completed a Lawson Materials & Finance Upgrade from 9.0 to 9.0.1 Applications in March 2012.
	Supported the job scheduler and built new jobs as requested.
	Did the monthly system closing for IC, RQ & PO running a job schedule and distributed reports to the materials staff.
	Supported all the Honeywell Handheld devices including reinitializing and complete setup.  The  wireless configuring was also handled by me.
	Supported the Lawson MSCM server for warehouse management as an administrator setting up users and locations.
	Set up all vendors used by North Memorial on EDI thru Lawson and tested transaction sets 810, 850 & 855 from North Memorial to GHX by respective vendor.
